answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent climbs one ridge of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified climbs instead of one free signup. No harbor of unearned reputation can shelter copies, because a relic record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
